subject: literacy
concept: Analyzing how setting and mood interact and influence a story's events
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student compares two versions of the same scene with different settings and discusses how the mood shifts
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a setting description to the mood it most likely creates
exercise.abstract: Student explains how a text's setting contributes to its mood and affects the story's events

misconception_flags: identifies the setting accurately but cannot connect it to the resulting mood or its effect on events

interest_binding: passage content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
